judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`), updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and added an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), but completely stopped before implementing the production code changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage across rounds, the newly added acceptance tests will fail. Additionally, the candidate missed renaming the hook parameter to `totalUsage` in `OrchestratorHooks` to make the signature unambiguous, and omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
